domains.title: Domains, links or emails
domains.description: One domain per line. A full link or an email is accepted and only the host is looked up, so https://www.example.com/pricing becomes example.com. Up to 100 domains per run.

includeDns.title: Also read DNS records
includeDns.description: Adds NS, MX, TXT, SPF and DMARC to every domain that has registry data, plus the resolver that answered. Turn it off when only the registration facts are needed: it makes a run faster.

maxDomains.title: Max domains
maxDomains.description: The list is cut here. Domains beyond the limit come back as rows with status NOT_CHECKED_LIMIT, their own line in input, and are not charged. 0 means no limit, and the summary reports the number actually applied.
